content.text: TERM DATES: Fall Start Date: 08/31/2026 - Fall End Date: 12/18/2026 Spring Start Date: 01/05/2026 - Spring End Date: 04/28/2026 RESTRICTED/LIMITED PROGRAMS: Enrollment in some courses in aviation, business, computer science, education, engineering, aerospace studies, interior design, and art may be limited. Engineering students should have at least a B-grade average (3.0 GPA), and may need to provide course descriptions in English of previous engineering coursework to demonstrate they meet engineering pre-requisites. Art students may be required to submit a portfolio, and music and theatre students may need to audition. Some colleges on campus charge "differential tuition," which is a surcharge attached to certain classes. More information on differential tuition can be found here: https://www.usu.edu/registrar/tuition/ in the appropriate "Tuition and Fee Schedule" link for the term you are attending. USU will pay an allowance of up to 6 credits of any undergraduate differential tuition for regular exchanges. If a student takes more than 6 credits worth of undergraduate differential tuition, the excess may be the responsibility of the student. No Number of reserved housing spaces: 0 Average Room Cost (per term): $2480 On-Campus Housing NOTES ABOUT ON-CAMPUS HOUSING: Most exchange students stay on campus -- if you choose to stay on campus, apply for housing as soon as possible after receiving your student A-number, as housing fills up fast. There is a Global Village themed residence hall (Jones Hall) that is suggested for students who would like to engage in intercultural activities and have roommates from around the world, including Utah. You can find more information on Jones Hall here: https://www.usu.edu/housing/single/student-living-center/jones.
